## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover it: unit tests (`make test`) and, for a feature, the end-to-end suite (`make e2e`)
- [ ] The web UI, the API and the CLI offer it alike, with the same names and checks
- [ ] `docs/spec.md` and the documentation in `website/index.html` describe the new behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased
- [ ] A new decision has its record in `docs/decisions/`
